references.text: The same command to strike the enemies with the ban and destroy them completely, without showing mercy.
Similar instructions to strike the city's inhabitants with the sword and take everything as plunder of war.
The execution of the ban in Jericho, where all living things were struck with the sword: both men and women, young and old, oxen, sheep, and donkeys.
Ai was destroyed in the same way, with all its inhabitants killed by the sword and the city burned down.
Joshua struck Makkedah with the sword and placed a ban on the city and everything living in it.
Joshua struck all the inhabitants with the sword and placed a ban on them, as Moses, the servant of the Lord, had commanded.
God's command to Saul to strike the Amalekites with the ban and kill both men and women, children and infants, oxen and sheep, camels and donkeys.
